base: T9_crossover theta_id=1 (d_111 = 3.84 nm at its top rung, nearest the 3.4 nm datum)
rationale: E_a0_conv is the ONLY strong temperature lever: its unary channel is Arrhenius and gives a 300->350 C rate ratio of 9.7-295 across [1.4,3.5], while the absorption gate dH2_abs_conv gives 0.98-1.92 over its whole range and the junction gate 1.12.  T9 data sorts perfectly on E_a0_conv (converts at 1.601, does not at 1.709+) and not at all on dH2_abs_conv.  The crossover therefore lives in a ~0.2 eV window; T9 sampled [1.4,3.5] uniformly, i.e. 10% of draws, and hit it zero times in 13 rows.  This scan puts every point inside the window.
